text:
sara: Heads-up — after flipping kernel=flashv3 for the apac-h100 pool on convo-svc canary, p95 for short payloads (<=8 tokens) jumped from ~42ms to ~92ms. Noticed across 3 canary nodes. Anyone else seeing this?

devops-bot: deployed convo-svc@canary -> apac-h100 (kernel=flashv3) at 2740012300 :rocket:

miguel: saw same on a single-node run. Quick micro-bench results:```
payloads=8 tokens, batch=1
old (triton-vendor): p50=30ms p95=42ms
flashv3: p50=28ms p95=92ms
notes: tail latency increases and CPU spin spikes when seq<16
```

oli: hmm that pattern screams small-batch kernel overhead (kernel launch or packing). flashv3 probably optimized for long sequences/packed batches. Did you try disabling continuous batching?

katherine: also check quant path. Are these models running q5/q8? flashv3 + q5 has different kernel paths. If canary used q5 and prod is q8 that could explain divergence.

miguel: can confirm canary is q8. ran a quick trace, KV cache hits OK. Kernel timeline snippet:```
[decode] kernel_launch (0.9ms)
[flashv3_attn] exec (70.2ms)
[post] memcpy  (1.1ms)
```
There are repeated 60-80ms spikes per token for short sequences.

oli: throwaway hypothesis: driver or libcudnn vendor fallback path triggered on H100 micro-ops for small N. We should repro on a single GPU with nvprof and compare flops occupancy.

ryan: I can run a targeted micro-bench on one apac-h100 box. Suggest variants: (1) flashv2, (2) flashv3, (3) triton-vendor, both q8 and q5, seq=4/8/32, batch=1/4. Will post logs.

katherine: for quick mitigation, add a routing rule to keep short-payloads on triton-vendor in apac until we root-cause. Example config snippet:```json
{"routing": {"region": "apac", "rule": [{"if": "payload_tokens <= 8", "prefer": "triton-vendor"}]}}
```
(This preserves latency SLO while we debug.)

sara: thanks. Plan: 1) ryan run micro-bench (+nvprof) and drop logs into #eng-ml-benchmarks 2) miguel/oli analyze kernel timelines 3) katherine apply temporary routing rule 4) follow up w/ vendor if kernel path looks wrong.

sara: @ryan assign me the canary pod logs and I'll roll back if routing rule not enough. :+1:

ryan: starting runs now, will post a short summary in ~30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
